meta.title: {app} — One task at a time
meta.description: {app} is a to-do app that only shows you the task that matters now. With your photo, PDF or web page always at hand.

hero.title: *One*|task|at a time
hero.lead: The to-do app that only shows you the task that matters now. Finish it and the next one appears.

muchas.title: You have|*too many*|things to do
muchas.lead: And you can only do one thing at a time.

una.title: Just *one*.|Until|it's done
una.lead: The current task fills the whole screen, like a sticky note. You don't move on to the next one until you complete it.

amano.title: Your photo, PDF,|web page.|*Always at hand*
amano.lead: Attach what you need to see: the timetable, the recipe, the map. Open the app and it's there, full screen, with no digging through your gallery and no reloading.

activa.title: The screen|*stays on*
activa.lead: If you want. Turn on “Keep screen on” and what you attached stays in view, at a glance, without touching your phone.
activa.note: Off by default. Works while a photo, PDF or web page is on screen.

luz.title: Your screen,|*a light table*
luz.lead: Turn on “Lock zoom” and the photo stays put: no zooming, no scrolling. Lay a sheet of paper on top and trace.

fin.title: Start|with *one*.
fin.lead: Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.
